messages:
alyssa: CI gpu-nightly (h100) is red on job 2859 — beam_search_long_seq_test is hanging around step ~64. tokens stop streaming and the process sits at 0% CPU for the container. dmesg shows intermittent Xid 79 and a short kernel stack trace. attaching logs below.

ci-bot: Job 2859 failed: exit code 137. Rerun link: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/2859

michael: thanks — can you paste the tail of the container logs and the image tag used?

alyssa: image: redwood/runner:gpu-2026-03-10 (CUDA 12.2). tail of container log: ```
[2026-03-10 14:02:11] INFO runner: starting test beam_search_long_seq_test
[2026-03-10 14:02:56] WARN attention: kv cache resize triggered
[2026-03-10 14:03:10] ERROR runtime: kernel launch returned unspecified error
[2026-03-10 14:03:10] INFO runtime: attempting graceful shutdown
--- then nothing, container unresponsive ---
```

jen: hmm, kernel launch unspecified + Xid 79 can be driver/runtime mismatch OR a bad kernel argument for long-seq attention. also could be a subtle GPU firmware issue.

ruth: quick triage checklist: 1) rerun the job to rule out transient. 2) try a repro locally with smaller env. 3) capture full dmesg and nvidia-smi from the node. 4) if reproducible, run cuda-memcheck.

kai: I'll start a narrow bisect across runtime/attention PRs from the last 48h (PRs touching src/runtime/attention or kernels). please leave the job logs in place.

michael: rerun command: `./ci rerun --job 2859 --lane gpu-nightly`

alyssa: rerun queued (thanks). local repro command I'm trying: ```
docker run --gpus all -it redwood/runner:gpu-2026-03-10 bash -c "python -m tests.long_sequence --case beam_search_long_seq_test --steps 100 --batch 1"
```

jen: if you get the hang locally, try setting `--num_tokens 512` and `--attention-block-size 64` to narrow down where it trips. also try an image with CUDA 12.1 if available.

ci-bot: Rerun started: job 2863 (rerun of 2859) — https://ci.redwood.ai/job/2863

kai: if rerun fails, i'll kick off bisect job now. can someone grab `dmesg -T | tail -n 200` from the node and paste output? Xid lines are the most useful.

alyssa: rerun finished and failed with same hang. dmesg excerpt: ```
Mar 10 14:03:12 node-12 kernel: NVRM: Xid (79): 0A9A69, PID=0, GPU=0, ChannelID=3, Reason: Pending
Mar 10 14:03:12 node-12 kernel: NVRM: GPU memory fault detected
```
and `nvidia-smi` on that node: ```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 525.85       Driver Version: 525.85       CUDA Version: 12.2       |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

ruth: good data. driver is 525.85 while infra mentioned some images on staging are running 526.05 — possible subtle runtime-driver mismatch when combined with the attention changes. I'll start the bisect across our PRs but add a driver-version guard.

michael: pinging infra: @ops-crew can you confirm whether any driver rotation or kernel updates hit the GPU fleet in the last 72h?

ops-crew: we did not push a host kernel update in prod. we rotated drivers on staging to 526.05 yesterday for tests, but prod nodes remain on 525.85. no BIOS/firmware patches applied.

jen: plan of action: ruth to bisect PRs touching attention/runtime, kai to run kernel-parameter/launch-args experiments, michael + ops to check node-level differences, alyssa to collect full repro artifacts (core dump, cuda-memcheck output if possible), i'll open an incident ticket if bisect pins a PR.

kai: bisect started. first candidate batch: PR#4120, PR#4123, PR#4131. I'll report earliest bad commit.

alyssa: collecting artifacts now. if anyone needs the runner container snapshot it's at `s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/job-2863/container-snapshot.tar.gz`. also attaching a cropped gdb backtrace I grabbed before the container froze: ```
#0  0x00007f8b ... cuLaunchKernel +0x45
#1  0x0000555f ... runtime::launch_attention_kernel
#2  0x0000552a ... runtime::forward
```

michael: thanks. small note — if bisect doesn't show a PR, try swapping to the staging driver (526.05) on a repro node; that will tell us whether driver is the multiplier.

jen: thumbs up. keep this channel updated with bisect results and any reproducible minimal test. adding :mag: and :hourglass_flowing_sand:.
